sample_findings.detail: Entry HTML loads 4 external <script type='module'> waterfall tags (max 2)
sample_findings.suggested_fix: Bundle application code into a single synchronous ./app.bundle.js without module waterfall chains.

sample_findings.detail: Entry HTML loads 3 external <link rel='stylesheet'> waterfall tags (max 2)
sample_findings.suggested_fix: Consolidate stylesheets into <= 2 local files (e.g. ./maat-tokens.css and ./app.bundle.css).

sample_findings.detail: script[4]@L28: async boot() awaits before first synchronous render() (blocks frame-1 paint)
sample_findings.suggested_fix: Render the initial shell synchronously on frame 1, then run async crypto/network hydration in the background.

sample_findings.detail: Disallowed <iframe src='https://example.com/legacy-embed'> violates strict CSP frame-src 'none' portability
sample_findings.suggested_fix: Remove <iframe src=...> or render content natively via Maat Safe-DOM primitives.

sample_findings.detail: External/path violates strict CSP img-src data: portability
sample_findings.suggested_fix: Replace external or path-based tags with inline Maat.svg() vectors or data: URIs.

sample_findings.detail: External <link href='https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;600&disp'> violates zero-dependency offline CSP portability
sample_findings.suggested_fix: Remove external font/CDN links and use local Maat CSS + system font stacks.
